name: coincident-cutter-entry
why: The boundary the sealed-void refusal must never cross. A cutter's outer face exactly on the face it enters is correct geometry — identical to standing it proud — and refuse-sealed-void's check fires 0.004 mm inside it. This pins the coincident row of the docs/GOTCHAS.md table so the topological rule can never quietly grow a tolerance that swallows it; v-block guards the same fact at a cut's exit.
